name: Compile URL( url ; hash )
purpose: Builds the URL for the embedded web app: requires url, takes the hash object (wrapped as {value:...} when it is not JSON), URL-encodes it on Mac/iOS, and on Windows puts hashes over 2000 characters on the clipboard (field 'CopyPasteField') and uses '#giant' instead. Returns url + hash.
open_question: Platform branches use Get(SystemPlatform) codes 1, 3 (URL-encode) and -2 (Windows long hash). The Windows path needs a global text field object on the layout (developer error dialog otherwise).
